answer_3.quote: We used GPT-4 to conduct a dialogue evaluation of LSTDial and its comparison models ... The instruction asks the LLM to provide both reasons and ratings for a given dialogue, evaluating fluency, relevance, diversity, engagement, coherence, and informativeness.

answer_4.quote: We employed three annotators to assess the quality of the responses generated on the DailyDialog dataset. Totally, 100 randomly sampled responses generated by each model are rated by each annotator on six different dimensions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each response on a scale of 1 to 3 (poor, normal, good) for six criteria.
